# Supplementary Materials

## Adapter Algorithm Example

The folgenden pseudocode describes the bottleneck adapter initialization used in our BERT model:

```python
import torch.nn as nn

class Adapter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, adapter_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.down_project = nn.Linear(input_dim, adapter_dim)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.up_project = nn.Linear(adapter_dim, input_dim)
        
    def forward(self, x):
        # Bottleneck architecture
        residual = x
        x = self.down_project(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.up_project(x)
        return x + residual
```
